scenes.say: A genus contains one or more related species and is narrower than a family. In the biological species concept, members can potentially interbreed and are reproductively isolated from other species. Fossils and asexual organisms need other criteria.
A radially symmetrical animal can be divided into similar halves along several planes through its central axis. A whale is a mammal. Mammary glands on its underside produce milk for the calf.
Keratinised scales cover a lizard and help protect its body on land. Many birds have scaly legs or feet beneath distinctly feathered bodies.
JAMB asks which category is most specific, how to recognise radial symmetry, and which feature identifies a whale as a mammal. The blue arrow traces narrowing from a genus to one example species.

quickCheck.prompt: Which rank is narrower than genus?
quickCheck.feedback: A genus can contain several related species.
